description: KORA company configuration. Company-specific features live here, not in code. Remove a section to switch that feature off. Validated on load (src/retrieval/config.py); Phase 5's UI will edit this file.

synonyms._comment: Company word list: everyday phrase -> the words your documents use. Matched as whole words (plural allowed); KORA searches with both and says so in the answer. Keep it short and add your own.

access._comment: Who may read which document. A document without a rule is open to everyone. Groups: all, manager, dept:<id>, loc:<id>, role:<id>, emp:<id> (from the employees table). Several matching rules: the user must pass all. These two rules are an EXAMPLE for Nexora; edit freely.

admins._comment: Phase 5: employees who may open the dashboards, edit settings and see colleagues' private details. Admins do NOT get extra document access: the access rules above still apply to them. Development login only; not production identity.

person_visibility._comment: PROVISIONAL (decide after testing employees of every level in the UI). Employee columns every colleague may see; all other columns (relocation, onboarding stage, join date, employment type) are visible only to the person and admins. Graph links follow the same rule: role_id -> has_role, dept_id -> works_in, location_id -> located_in, manager_id -> reports_to, international_relocation_germany -> eligible_for.

graph._comment: Phase 5: answer relationship questions (who owns / approves / is involved, what depends on what, why delayed) from the knowledge graph. Only documented links are stated; everything else goes to the normal answer flow.

communication.note: Tone profiles describe common workplace tendencies, not rules about any individual. A person's own stated preference always comes first, and company policy is separate from cultural guidance (see DOC-COMM-001).
